title: Color in Layout
slide_intent: Show how color changes in importance as it moves from the overall page to the content area and the image. That order lets a reader recognize the source before inspecting the subject.
strategic_value: Using a core field beneath the logo can anchor the composition while a smaller secondary area responds to the photograph.
demonstration: An exploded layout joins a pale core frame, a smaller colored content field and a photograph with plus signs. The labels give 3:2 primary to secondary color and 2:1 secondary color to photography.
practical_value: Use the two labeled relationships to compare layer sizes in a campaign layout. Choose the secondary hue in relation to the image.

content_islands.name: Role guidance
content_islands.spec: Keep the explanation and numbered usage rules in a left-hand column.

content_islands.name: Layer diagram
content_islands.spec: Arrange the core frame, colored headline panel and photograph from left to right, decreasing the area as shown. Label the two proportions above the panels.
